name: anon-rpc demo — balance watcher
description: Watches an ETH balance, with every RPC call made by hash-pinned worker code in a sandboxed page. A demo of the anon-rpc standard.
//permissions: offscreen gives the extension a DOM to hold the §6 iframe in; storage keeps settings across popup opens and service-worker restarts.
//host_permissions: For the OFFSCREEN document's fetch of the worker bundle from whichever resolver the specifier names, and for the service worker's own bootstrap RPC call (§4). Broad because a demo lets you point it anywhere; a real wallet would list its own endpoints. The WORKER's requests do not use these — it runs at a null origin and is subject to CORS like any web page.
//sandbox: The §6 isolation boundary. Listing the page here is what serves it at an opaque origin with its own CSP — the only CSP an extension may relax, and the only way the worker's blob: chain can run.

content_security_policy.//sandbox: blob: in script-src is required because the worker runtime and the worker bundle are both importScripts'd from blob URLs, and importScripts is checked against script-src rather than worker-src.
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob:; child-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src *;
